_comment: AI-ASSISTED SCAFFOLD from CLARENCE_ZHEN_JIN_TAN_SPECIALISED_WORK_PACKAGE.md sec 3 (mandatory pre-code reconciliation) and its review (CA-1, CA-3, CA-4, CA-6). NOT authorship evidence. Clarence must inspect, correct in his own words, take the team decisions himself, and obtain review. Institutional cells (approver/date/decision_log_ref) are explicit PENDING and must NOT be backfilled from memory after results are seen (WP sec 3).

rows.question: What are the frozen machine contracts for ApplicationEnvelope, terminal DecisionEnvelope, public/staff projections and field-level disclosure classes?
options_considered: prose-only Section 14 contract
separate hand-maintained public and staff schemas
one staff-complete schema + fail-closed class-driven projection + executable invariants
rows.chosen_option: one staff-complete schema + fail-closed class-driven projection + executable invariants
rows.rationale: Single source of truth with a derived public view makes evidence symmetry and value-level non-interference provable (CA-1); fail-closed projection makes WP 15.2 hold by construction; digests give semantic replay.
rows.approver: PENDING: Michael (evidence semantics) + Wesley (transport/version/auth) at the contract workshop
rows.date: PENDING: give this the FIRST date (CA-3)
rows.decision_log_ref: PENDING: bind to canonical decision-log ID
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Build nothing UI-shaped; deterministic template rendering only over the DecisionEnvelope until schemas freeze.

rows.question: What is the referent of L_reliance, given that P0 and P1 differ precisely in what is displayed (CA-1)?
options_considered: displayed-evidence referent (status quo — inverts the construct)
terminal DecisionEnvelope evidence state (identical across conditions by design)
rows.chosen_option: terminal DecisionEnvelope evidence state (identical across conditions by design)
rows.rationale: A system must not be able to score 'safer by showing less'. Binding to the fixed terminal decision, enforced by INV-NONINTERFERENCE, measures reliance against the same evidence regardless of interface condition.
rows.owner: PENDING: single named owner shared with Fahmi (also register as F-BLOCK-09)
rows.approver: PENDING: Clarence + Fahmi joint, at ratification
rows.decision_log_ref: PENDING: open jointly as C-BLOCK-15 / F-BLOCK-09
tests_required: paired P0/P1/P2 identical DecisionEnvelope digest fixture
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Do not report any reliance result; measure only against the terminal decision state or withhold the claim.
rows.status: DRAFTED (disposition in docs/applications/C-BLOCK-05.md; blocker not yet opened jointly)

rows.question: How do we prevent a public and staff implementation silently diverging?
options_considered: manual review of parity
executable evidence-symmetry / semantic-replay / value-level non-interference gates in CI
rows.chosen_option: executable evidence-symmetry / semantic-replay / value-level non-interference gates in CI
rows.rationale: Parity that is not executable is aspirational (WP sec 8). The gates already run over fixtures in the C-BLOCK-05 package.
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Ship public surface only via deterministic templates over the projected DecisionEnvelope.

rows.question: How do we stop a map, client sort or browse fallback bypassing model abstention or the certified order?
options_considered: trust client rendering
freeze selected-slate / supported-pool / map-list parity / display-order receipt rules and test them
rows.chosen_option: freeze selected-slate / supported-pool / map-list parity / display-order receipt rules and test them
rows.rationale: Client sort/map/pagination must never change eligibility or certified order; enforced by INV-SLATE-ORDER and the immutable ordered candidate list in the DecisionEnvelope.
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: List view only; no map, no client-side sort.

rows.question: How do we stop the chatbot streaming an unsupported sentence before verification?
options_considered: stream free model text then post-check
prohibit unverified factual-token streaming; release verified claim chunks or deterministic templates only
rows.chosen_option: prohibit unverified factual-token streaming; release verified claim chunks or deterministic templates only
rows.rationale: Verify-before-render (section-8.3 clause 3); the verifier sits downstream of the model and only verification==verified claims render (INV-NO-UNVERIFIED).
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Deterministic template rendering only; no LLM in the response path.
rows.status: PARTIAL (contract field + invariant exist; rendering pipeline not built)

rows.question: How is schedule horizon and outside-horizon behaviour handled so it is never read as a non-match?
options_considered: treat outside-horizon as no-match (prohibited)
ratify horizon + explicit typed outside-horizon UI state
rows.chosen_option: ratify horizon + explicit typed outside-horizon UI state
rows.rationale: Outside-horizon must fail to a typed state, never a false negative; the DecisionEnvelope's scope_qualifier and coverage_qualifier carry it.
tests_required: outside-horizon renders as typed state not bounded_non_match
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Show scope_indeterminate and withhold any non-match claim outside the ratified horizon.
rows.status: PARTIAL (contract carries the state; horizon value unratified)

rows.question: Who is the accountable Section 08 (chatbot) owner, and what is the component-level split?
options_considered: leave implicit (prohibited — CA-4)
ratify accountable owner + component split (parser/orchestrator/claim-contract/model-runtime/evaluation) bound to a real decision-log ID
rows.chosen_option: ratify accountable owner + component split (parser/orchestrator/claim-contract/model-runtime/evaluation) bound to a real decision-log ID
rows.rationale: Section 08 has no RATIFY-08-* register; the decision must bind to a real canonical ID before Phase A closes (CA-4). Clarence's defensible wording stays 'conversational-UX & application-integration owner' until then.
rows.owner: PENDING TEAM (Clarence coordinates the conversational-UX component only)
rows.decision_log_ref: PENDING: create canonical decision-log ID (do NOT invent RATIFY-08-*)
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Clarence builds only the conversational-UX/presentation component; no claim to chatbot ownership.

rows.question: Is Clarence integration lead for both applications, or are there separate public/staff product owners?
options_considered: Clarence owns both (Section 19 as written)
Clarence integration lead + named public/staff product leads
explicitly amend the allocation
rows.chosen_option: PENDING TEAM: ratify Clarence as integration lead + named public/staff product leads OR amend
rows.rationale: Section 19 vs the crosswalk disagree; do not invent the answer in code (RATIFY-19-06 seen from Clarence's side).
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Clarence proceeds as integration lead; product-lead gaps recorded as open.

rows.question: Who is the eligible non-author HCI/accessibility reviewer of Clarence's applications (RATIFY-14-02)?
options_considered: Clarence reviews own work (prohibited — WP 2.6)
name an internal eligible non-author reviewer
use an external accessibility reviewer if internal independence is inadequate
rows.chosen_option: PENDING: name eligible non-author reviewer; external route if internal independence inadequate
rows.rationale: Clarence cannot be RATIFY-14-02; accessibility conformance needs independent evidence (C-BLOCK-11).
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Report technical accessibility inspection only; make no conformance claim.

rows.question: Who holds the Section 15 operational authorities (service, data-governance, security, ethics-route, incident, partner, residual-risk)?
options_considered: leave unassigned (prohibited)
name each authority through Section 15
rows.rationale: Clarence coordinates but cannot issue these determinations (WP 2.4). An orphan authority blocks the affected maturity state.
tests_required: authority map has no orphan use/harm/control/reviewer
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Maturity stays research_demonstration; no public/pilot exposure.

rows.question: How do we stop application effects being confounded with retrieval/ranking/content differences?
options_considered: compare whole systems
freeze P0/P1/P2 and W0/W1/W1-NA sharing controlled backends/cases
rows.chosen_option: freeze P0/P1/P2 and W0/W1/W1-NA sharing controlled backends/cases
rows.rationale: Isolates the interface/conversation effect at matched backend semantics (WP 13.1); enables CA-1's shared referent. Fahmi owns the estimands and analysis; Clarence builds the controlled conditions.
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: No cross-condition effect claim; report per-condition descriptives only.

rows.question: How do we stop exact origin, raw dialogue and preference memory becoming persistent personal data through telemetry?
options_considered: log freely and redact later
freeze telemetry dictionary + data-flow map + transient-by-default + retention/deletion + hosted-model data path before collection
rows.chosen_option: freeze telemetry dictionary + data-flow map + transient-by-default + retention/deletion + hosted-model data path before collection
rows.rationale: Design transient-by-default from the first line of code; coarsened_origin only, no raw utterance/exact location in telemetry (WP 12.5, 13.3).
tests_required: telemetry schema forbids raw utterance/exact location
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: No telemetry collection; deterministic conformance evidence only.

rows.question: How do we avoid mistaking WCAG scanning for accessibility validation?
options_considered: automated scan only (prohibited as validation)
freeze manual/browser/device/AT/low-bandwidth and non-map/no-chat test matrices
rows.chosen_option: freeze manual/browser/device/AT/low-bandwidth and non-map/no-chat test matrices
rows.rationale: One examiner-found failure falsifies a conformance claim; scoped, dated, self-evaluated matrices survive (WP 11).
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: Claim 'evaluated toward WCAG 2.2 AA within the tested matrix' only.

rows.question: What does 'functioning' mean, so it is not misread as public production deployment?
options_considered: public internet deployment
end-to-end compatible local/authorised-staging research system
rows.rationale: Public internet deployment requires separate Section 15/16 maturity gates; do not call a staging build a public deployment (WP 12.9, 19.3).

rows.question: Who owns and reviews the Section 18 partner pathway?
options_considered: Clarence owns the whole partner pathway
Clarence owns only application/action-card integration until wider responsibility is ratified
rows.chosen_option: Clarence owns only application/action-card integration until wider responsibility is ratified
rows.rationale: Section 18 has no RATIFY-18-* register; bound scope until named (WP 2.5, C-BLOCK-13).
rows.owner: PENDING TEAM (Clarence: action-card UI integration only)
tests_required: action-card state machine cannot skip approval
rows.fallback_if_unresolved: No partner-pathway ownership claim; integration surface only.
